title: United States
attribution: World Climate Simulation materials by Climate Interactive, MIT Sloan, and the UMass Lowell Climate Change Initiative. Updated November 2025. Adapted for nested-agent experiments.
goals: Protect the economy, jobs, national security and affordability
Address climate risks within a politically divided federal policy environment
Seek reciprocal emissions action by China and developing countries
negotiating_constraints: The November 2025 brief describes withdrawal from the Paris Agreement and promotion of fossil fuel development
Do not place an undue economic burden on the US while developing-country emissions continue to grow
China must cut emissions for the US to consider action
adaptation_notes: Goals and qualitative constraints paraphrase the briefing. Baseline commitments, numeric ceilings, finance-role restrictions, personalities and scoring are author-created experimental assumptions, NOT official prescribed positions. Source text reflects November 2025 and is not a live policy fact-check.
